agents.name: Code Review Agent
agents.description: Use when: reviewing changed .NET 10 API and Angular 19 code for bugs, security risks, architecture drift, memory leaks, streaming issues, and missing tests. Findings first.

agents.name: Feature Orchestrator
agents.description: Use when: turning a vague feature idea into an implementation-ready .NET 10 + Angular 19 technical plan. Acts as a single supervisor in a DAG of agents; never writes or reviews code itself.

agents.name: Implementation Agent
agents.description: Use when: implementing an approved plan in this .NET 10 + Angular 19 workspace with a tight edit/validate loop. Reads locally, edits narrowly, builds/tests, fixes local failures, and summarizes results.

agents.name: RAG Debugger
agents.description: Use when: debugging AI/RAG answer quality, retrieval ranking, embeddings, prompt behavior, Ollama availability, sanitization, or telemetry in the AI-Learn app.

agents.name: Test Strategist
agents.description: Use when: designing focused backend, frontend, integration, and smoke tests for a changed .NET 10 + Angular 19 AI feature. Prioritizes behavior and risk over broad test volume.

agents.name: ai-feature-spec
agents.description: Generate exhaustive, production-grade technical specifications for .NET 10 APIs, Angular 19 Signal stores, DTO contracts, and test strategies.

agents.description: Perform automated, comprehensive code review for .NET 10 API and Angular 19 codebases. Audits architectural alignment, type safety, security, performance, and memory leaks.
